piece.name: Gaslight Strut
piece.title: Gaslight Strut
piece.notes: Cakewalk syncopation transplanted into D dorian -- for fun, testing how far the tresillo groove travels outside plain major. Same proven architecture as Cakewalk Strut v2 (ABA form, groove:'broken' at density:'full', swing:0.0, real breakdown before the reprise), just a different mode entirely. Dorian's signature color is its major IV (raised 6th relative to natural minor) -- i-IV (Dm-G) is the classic dorian vamp, so the progressions lean on that i-bVII-IV-i shape throughout rather than the plain I-IV-V-I of the original. Moodier, jazzier, more noir than the parlor-piano original -- same strut, different lighting.

sections.name: intro
sections.notes: Vamp on i-v, establishes the dorian minor color before IV's brightness shows up in strain A.

sections.name: strain_a
sections.notes: Main strain -- i-IV is dorian's signature move, the major IV lifting out of the minor tonic. root_fifth bass stays steady while the tresillo cuts across it, same tension as the original.

sections.name: strain_b
sections.notes: Contrasting strain -- bVII-IV adds the other dorian-defining color (both chords major, floating free of the minor tonic's gravity). One light countermelody above.

sections.name: breakdown
sections.notes: The eye of the storm, same move as the original -- no groove, no counterpoint, pedal bass, high rest_probability.

sections.name: strain_a_reprise
sections.notes: Return of strain A, rebuilding out of the breakdown.

sections.name: outro
sections.notes: Short closing tag, resolves to the minor tonic.
